messages:
Jules (Partner Ops): Hey team — kicking off the Rigel HW preview. Need a quick sync on NDA state, bench plan, and telemetry requirements. Can folks drop status? :v:
Alex Chen: NDA signed by legal last night, copy in the partner drive: s3://partners/rigel/nda.pdf
Maria Gonzales: Great. For benchmarks I want to run perf and perf-regression suites (latency p50/p95, memory, throughput). Suggest a 3-day smoke then extended run.
Samir Patel: For infra: we need v4 images, CUDA 12.2, drivers pinned. Also need an SSH jump host + ephemeral creds. Will prepare a terraform snippet.
Rigel Eng (partner): Confirmed driver versions. We can provide 2 racks in week of Apr 8. Telemetry endpoint will be an SQS forwarder — pending your schema.
Jules (Partner Ops): Thanks. Telemetry schema: minimal tokenized counters, model_id, sequence_len, latency_ms, error_code. We should avoid PII. Maria/Samir can you review? @IntegrationsBot please create a checklist.
IntegrationsBot: Checklist created: 1) NDA uploaded 2) Bench infra provisioned 3) Telemetry schema approved 4) Data egress rules 5) Final run scheduled
Maria Gonzales: Quick note on telemetry: include `kv_cache_hit_rate` and `batch_size` in the schema. Example payload:
```
{ "model_id":"redwood/rw2-13b", "seq_len":256, "latency_ms":42, "kv_cache_hit_rate":0.92, "batch_size":8 }
```
Alex Chen: For benchmarks, let's do: 1) single-request latency (cold/warm) 2) steady-state throughput @1000 concurrent 3) autoscaling stress test. We'll store results in the partner bucket `s3://bench-results/rigel/`.
Samir Patel: Terraform snippet (pseudocode) I'll drop in the drive. Also we need firewall rules: allow 10.10.0.0/16 to our observability collector (443) and block all egress except partner bucket.
Jules (Partner Ops): Ops/Legal action items: Alex will own bench harness, Maria will own telemetry schema, Samir owns infra. I'll coordinate dates and comms with Rigel. Aim to start smoke on Apr 10. Any blockers?
Rigel Eng (partner): No blockers from our side. Can we get a short runbook for rolling back dev machines if we hit overheating? We had one event last quarter.
Samir Patel: Yes — I'll write a hardware safety runbook and include thermal thresholds and auto-shutdown hooks.
Alex Chen: I'll prepare a minimal harness that can run the perf scripts and emit the telemetry format. Will share a PR by EOD.
Jules (Partner Ops): Awesome — thanks all. I'll post a calendar invite and the drive links. :rocket:
